daily.title: Fatal hit-and-run driver thought he had hit animal, court hears
daily.summary: A 20-year-old hit-and-run driver who fatally struck a woman in Adelaide's north-east has apologised to his victim's family in court, which heard he did not initially realise he had hit a person.

daily.title: Police speak with four men over Sydney Swans scandal
daily.summary: Victoria Police detectives confirm they have spoken with four Sydney men as part of their sexual assault investigation linked to the Sydney Swans.

daily.title: Judge tells retiring triple murder jury to consider if survivor truthful
daily.summary: A jury has retired to consider its verdict in the trial of a Queensland grazier accused of a triple murder and an attempted murder.

daily.title: Another plan unveiled to tackle long-standing issues in Port Augusta
daily.summary: The state government has announced another plan to tackle issues regarding crime, violence and substance abuse in Port Augusta. The efforts have been praised by Indigenous leaders who say it is needed, but have criticised the lack of Indigenous consultation.

daily.title: 'The Family' serial killings suspects should be named, victims' relatives say
daily.summary: Relatives of some of the victims of "The Family" murders are demanding the public release of the long-suppressed names of suspects linked to the case.

daily.title: The turquoise home that withstood a torrent
daily.summary: Inside the turquoise house close to the riverbank, a mother of two, her husband, daughter and in-laws remained stranded on their balcony as the flood tore through their Nepali town.

daily.title: Telstra outage caused by failure to address well-known network issues
daily.summary: Telstra failed to prioritise fixing known vulnerabilities in its systems despite being warned about them months before they triggered a major nationwide outage.

daily.title: Case against Lizzo's Big Grrl Touring company dropped by federal judge
daily.summary: A district judge in the US has cleared Lizzo's touring company of wrongdoing after allegations of discrimination and harassment were filed by a former wardrobe assistant.

daily.title: Man sentenced to two years in jail over deepfake images of women and children
daily.summary: Antonio Rotondo was found guilty on Tuesday of creating and distributing "profoundly violating" and "degrading" deepfakes of Brisbane women and children.

daily.title: Four Australians found in Nepal, but dozens of others still missing
daily.summary: A week on from the flood disaster, another four Australians have been found safe.

daily.title: Man who slipped in McDonald's sought more than $2 million in damages
daily.summary: A man who slipped near a wet floor sign at a Canberra McDonald's is awarded nearly $15,000 in compensation, after initially seeking millions.

daily.title: Key player in Melbourne tobacco wars to spend at least three years behind bars
daily.summary: A key lieutenant of jailed tobacco kingpin Kazem Hamad will spend at least three years behind bars for orchestrating arsons and car thefts at the height of Victoria's tobacco wars.

daily.title: Man convicted of National Zoo stabbing murder has small legal win
daily.summary: A man who murdered his colleague at Canberra's National Zoo and Aquarium has had three and a half years shaved off his 30-year sentence after an appeal.

daily.title: Hate and vilification charges laid after alleged threats of violence
daily.summary: Police say they have charged a man in Far North Queensland over ideologically motivated threats of violence.

daily.title: Man shot dead in Sydney home invasion appears to be 'innocent'
daily.summary: NSW police commissioner says a man shot dead in a Sydney home invasion appears to be an "innocent life" lost to organised crime.

daily.title: Clarkson sacked as Kangaroos hunt 'coach for the modern game'
daily.summary: North Melbourne president Sonja Hood and football boss Todd Viney address the media after the decision to part ways with senior coach Alastair Clarkson.

daily.title: Australian economy grows faster than expected, raising rate hike risk
daily.summary: Australia's economy grew 0.4 per cent in the June quarter, slightly beating most economist forecasts and further raising the prospect of an interest rate hike as soon as this month.

daily.title: More than 5,000 sheep worth $1.7m stolen from property in rural Qld
daily.summary: Detectives from the Rural and Stock Crime Squad are asking anyone who may have seen a flock of dorper sheep "matching the description" to come forward.

daily.title: Buffalo attack in Northern Territory leaves tourist shaken
daily.summary: Two young tourists say they've never been more scared in their lives after 21-year-old Victorian woman Emma Hipwell was charged by a wild buffalo while holidaying in the Northern Territory.

daily.title: Mine considered 'beating heart' of small Tasmanian town to reopen
daily.summary: Mining company Sibanye-Stillwater hopes to have the Mt Lyell copper mine near Queenstown back up and running in 2029, creating 300 jobs in the process.

daily.title: Prosecutors allowed to seek death penalty in Charlie Kirk murder case
daily.summary: A judge has ruled that Tyler Robinson, the man accused of fatally shooting Charlie Kirk last year, should face trial on murder charges in a case eligible for the death penalty.

daily.title: Live: Hadley sent text message saying Jones 'needs to be destroyed', court told
daily.summary: Retired 2GB radio host Ray Hadley has resumed giving evidence at Alan Jones's indecent assault and sexual touching trial.

daily.title: Ferrari's Schumacher-inspired livery, F1 leader to cop penalty in Italy
daily.summary: Ferrari will be celebrating the legacy of Michael Schumacher this weekend at its home race, with special livery dedicated to the seven-time Formula 1 world champion.

daily.title: Meet the emerging artists featured in Primavera 2026
daily.summary: Primavera's 2026 exhibition features Australian artists aged 35 or younger.

daily.title: AFP raid Melbourne home of former CFMEU official
daily.summary: Federal police officers have raided the home of a former senior official of the militant construction union as part of their probe into corruption in the building industry.

developing.title: Live: ASX falls sharply, oil hits two-month high amid US-Iran strikes
developing.summary: The Australian share market is recording heavy losses after the US launched fresh strikes against Iran, driving oil prices up and contributing to a global bond sell-off. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Four more Australians confirmed safe in Nepal-Tibet flood disaster
developing.summary: Four more Australians have been confirmed safe after the Nepal-Tibet flood, with the number of unaccounted-for Australians revised down to 38. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Iran says US will 'regret' new wave of attacks
developing.summary: The new round of strikes comes after Iran attempted to attack American troops and commercial ships in the region, according to US central command. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Hadley sent text message saying Jones 'needs to be destroyed', court told
developing.summary: Retired 2GB radio host Ray Hadley has resumed giving evidence at Alan Jones's indecent assault and sexual touching trial.
